Larkmere Ramblers
Invented Fernhollow Ramble: Trail Guide for tests
Part One (roughly 4 miles)
0.0  Set off from the Fernhollow Trailhead beside 812 Tansy Street, West Larkmere, QX, walking toward the old mill.
0.84  Fork right beside the rusty pump house.
1.62  Climb the stone steps and keep the fence on your right.
2.30  Duck under the Quillby Bridge (1931), QX-41/RT-7.
2.95*  Stop at the Ottermere Marina, which has a water tap and three portable toilets.  Afterwards stroll past Pennywhistle Cafe, 77 Sorrel Place, Dunmarrow, ZQ.
3.40  Keep walking past the Ottermere Marina on the gravel lane.
3.88  Hug the reservoir shore and carry on to Brackenfield.
Part Two (roughly 5 miles)
5.12  Veer onto the left-hand spur where two cairns stand.
6.07*  Reach Thistledown Park, with benches and a restroom block.
6.55  Step across QX-12 (Mallow Road) at the zebra crossing.
7.18  Saunter beside the Dunmarrow Canal for a while.
8.02  Wander under the Hobnail Viaduct and out onto the meadow.
8.77*  Finish at the bandstand in Merrowgate Green, Dunmarrow.
Toilets are marked with a star. Every name on this sheet is made up.
